prompt: Fix the pricing module so repeated requests for the same currency do not perform redundant fetches. Preserve the public functions and verify the behavior.
expected_behavior: Repeated requests for one currency fetch once; different currencies still fetch independently.
failure_conditions: same currency triggers more than one fetch
different currencies share an incorrect value

evaluation.reason: 課題の機能要件だけでは不要な複雑さを減らす効果を測れない。正確性の後に依存と構造を評価する必要がある。
evaluation.use: 個別契約の回帰資料。skillの採否には使用しない
